Hair transplant techniques — FUE, DHI, FUT

The three Tier-1 spokes off /hair-transplant-in-gurgaon, built on the same system as the hub, the beard page and the PRP page.

Same house layout on all three, deliberately different clinical content: body-copy overlap between any two is 11–14%, and that figure includes the shared header, footer, doctor block, reviews and contact sections. Swap the acronym on any page and it stops making sense — which is the test.

Three tweak chips above each artboard:
• Show working notes — the SEO spec at the bottom. Off = production page.
• Show stats — the 4.8 star line.
• Show graft counts — before/after metadata, keep off until the pairs are verified.

What carries each page:

FUE — "a graft is not a hair", and the three questions that make quotes comparable. Written around donor arithmetic and over-harvesting.

DHI — a stage-by-stage table of what the implanter actually changes, the DHT-is-a-hormone correction, and a cost section that argues against whole-case DHI.

FUT — the scar, unsoftened, plus four questions to ask before agreeing to a strip. The only page on the site that argues against its own procedure for most readers.

⚠ FUT — DO NOT PUBLISH YET. The hub badges FUT "Selected cases" and its working note still lists "confirmation that FUT is offered" as outstanding. This page markets a surgical procedure. It needs written confirmation that FUT is performed at the clinic, by whom and with what dissection setup — or it should become an educational /fue-vs-fut comparison instead. The blocker is repeated in red at the bottom of the FUT artboard.
